content.comment_body: I realize this topic has appeared before. I'm attempting to redirect via a virtual RS232 port to communicate with [product_name]. I come close to establishing a connection, but the [product_name] configuration software loses connection after about 3 seconds. It seems I might need to send a specific string or command to maintain the handshake. When I use HyperTerminal, I can connect and transmit data without being disconnected. I've tried all the usual troubleshooting steps such as adjusting COM port settings and protocol options, but nothing has worked so far. Any detailed information about the communication protocol would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters brief connectivity when trying to use a virtual RS232 port with [product_name] configuration software, but the connection drops after a few seconds unless continuous communication occurs. The connection remains stable with HyperTerminal, highlighting a possible issue with protocol handling or software compatibility in the [product_name] configuration tool.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a reliable and stable connection with [product_name] configuration software over a virtual RS232 port, similar to the consistency experienced when using HyperTerminal.
